No credentials or private data were sent.

The current official group catalogue places only MBA under Aryakul College of Management and places BBA and other undergraduate programmes under Aryakul College of Education. A legacy official /bba/ page conflicts with that current institution-level catalogue, so BBA was excluded rather than guessed as an ACM programme.

Official MBA pages disagree on eligibility thresholds: the institution-specific programme page states 45% General/OBC and 40% SC/ST, while the central Admission page states 50% General/OBC/Minority and 45% SC/ST. Eligibility is therefore left null rather than selecting between conflicting official statements.
